title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-31 current Weber author record: source-checked repair through Volume III section 69
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The page keeps broad working readers for Lehrbuch der Algebra while a source-checkable German/English repair stream replaces weaker Volume II and III translation drafts section by section.

Status at a glance. [#########-] broad draft available; source-checked repair stream now covers Volume II tail material plus Volume III sections 1-69 as paired German source and English translation readers. Volumes I and III have original-language modern LaTeX readers, and Volume I also has an English working reader. The next continuation point is Volume III section 70.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, component PDFs, earlier section pairs, provenance notes, and source material for continued checking.
notes: Latest update supplies paired German/English high-fidelity readers for the Volume II tail and Volume III sections 1-69.
